This application/project (MiniiChat Next) is a work developed by director_Carter based on MiniiChat (MIT open source) MiniiChat Next is an AGPL-3.0 open source Android LLM client, which adds more functions (MCP service support, tool calling, file operations, etc.) on the original basis.

You may call tools when appropriate. Rules:
- Only call a tool when the user clearly needs it; don't call tools just to appear helpful
- If the user's intent is unclear, ask first instead of blindly listing directories
- Never call the same tool twice in one request
- Always pass concrete argument values

Ask the user to confirm or clarify a request, preference or plan. Shows a question with up to 4 preset options; the user can pick one, pick several, or type a custom answer at the end.
Run a shell (sh/bash) script or terminal command on this Android device; returns stdout and stderr.
List files and subdirectories under a directory. Returns name, type and size.
Read a text file. You can pass a max byte count; default 256KB.
Write text to a file (overwrite). Missing parent directories are created automatically.
Append text to the end of a file. Creates the file if it doesn\'t exist.
Delete a file or directory. Directories are removed recursively.

Recursively search a directory for file names containing a keyword; returns matching paths.

Fetch a web page and return its content as Markdown. Args: url (required), ua (optional: mobile/desktop/custom:<ua>), mode (optional: auto/http/render — render uses a real WebView to bypass bot-blocks), timeout_seconds (optional, default 15). Current default UA mode: %1$s

Edit a file by replacing old_text with new_text. Matching falls back: exact → line-trimmed (indentation tolerant) → block anchor (first/last line). Use replace_all for multiple replacements.

{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"file to edit\"},\"old_text\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"exact text to replace (copy from recent file_read)\"},\"new_text\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"replacement text (empty string deletes)\"},\"replace_all\":{\"type\":\"boolean\",\"description\":\"replace all occurrences (default false: exactly one match required)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\",\"old_text\"]}
